directive: OPERATOR_3_emphasis.md: make the cost of preservation explicit so a lost datum is not read as a design mistake

cost_classes.CHEAP: one extra write of a value already in memory at that moment
cost_classes.MODERATE: a new record type or a schema change, no new computation
cost_classes.EXPENSIVE: new computation or storage that scales with population x time
cost_classes.STRUCTURALLY_DIFFICULT: the information is not present at any single point in the code path (would need re-architecture or instrumentation of another component)

rows.where_lost: poet_algo.py get_child_list() returns it in a tuple; adjust_envs_niches() creates the optimizer without writing it; only logger.info text survives
rows.why: the id is in hand at add_optimizer(); one field in the CSV header or the best.json

rows.where_lost: es.py update_pata_ec() overwrites self.pata_ec each adjustment; never serialised
rows.why: a per-adjustment snapshot file keyed by (iteration, optim_id); the basis (which optimizers, in what order) must be written with it or the vector is meaningless later

rows.datum: rejected children and their novelty scores
rows.where_lost: get_child_list() sorts and truncates to max_admitted; the rest are dropped with a debug line

rows.datum: transfer provenance beyond the source id string
rows.where_lost: pick_proposal() logs accept_theta_in_<id>=<source>; the proposed theta after the ES step and the direct-vs-proposed choice are not kept
rows.why: theta is a large vector; keeping every proposal scales with pairs, but keeping the ACCEPTED one and a flag is one write
needs an intervention/ablation apparatus the optimizer does not have; this is the causal fossil the directive names

rows.datum: which artifact an agent read or copied when writing a new one
rows.where_lost: the environment logs observation text and the action, not a provenance edge; 006_artifact_philogeny.py reconstructs by text match or LLM
rows.why: the agent's tool call that read an artifact is an event the environment sees; recording (reader, artifact_id, tick) at read time is a schema addition, not new computation; attributing INFLUENCE from it is still inference

rows.datum: deterministic confidence for an ancestry edge
rows.where_lost: the confidence is the model's self-report
rows.why: no ground truth exists inside the system; only an independent interaction history (TECHNE-108) can grade it

rows.datum: population with ancestry at the end of the run
rows.where_lost: stock events.cfg never calls SavePopulation; the smoke reads count.dat
rows.why: one event line; Avida already tracks the genotypes

rows.datum: simulation state behind each embedded frame
rows.where_lost: rollout.py return_state=False by default; published .npz carry params/embeddings
rows.why: state per frame scales with grid x time; the metric never consumes it, so nothing in the pipeline asks for it
the compression IS the method; TECHNE-107 measures what survives it

rows.datum: organisms that never earned a permanent name
rows.where_lost: gene bank admission (to be read in rambank.c/diskbank.c, TECHNE-106)
rows.why: the admission rule is the object of TECHNE-106

constraints_from_directive_3: PATA-EC is a phenotype of (world x contemporary population), not of the world: P_t(E) != P_{t+k}(E) for a byte-identical E. VERIFIED_SOURCE: poet_algo.py:296-299 recomputes update_pata_ec() for every active AND archived optimizer at each adjust_envs_niches(), against the optimizers present at that moment; the basis grows as the archive grows (hence the padded distance in novelty.py). Any reuse of PATA-EC for 'persistent pressure' must record the basis with the vector.

Do NOT collapse novelty of structure / novelty of behaviour / novelty to an observer / historically consequential novelty into one field in any mechanism catalog. No MECHANISM_CATALOG.json exists in the repository today (git ls-files, 2026-09-17); the constraint binds whoever creates one and is posted to Nyx.

Keep organism ancestry (recorded reproduction provenance, Avida) and conceptual ancestry (inferred cultural descent, TerraLingua) as two graph types; an edge A -> B has different epistemic status in each.
